probes.summary: SDK imports on Node 22 and exact versions are recorded.
Verified bundled CLI size, SHA-256 and executable version.
Current endpoint returned Anthropic Messages HTTP 200 and completed an SDK query.
SDK init reported gpt-5.6-sol as the active model.
Session ID persisted and resume returned the exact prior-turn nonce.
Read, Write, Edit and Bash completed in an isolated workspace.
Project CLAUDE.md and a projected skill both produced deterministic markers.
Tool calls/results were observable before the terminal result.
Abort stops the SDK process but a Bash descendant ran to natural completion and retained the workspace handle.
The current environment is Windows and the verified path does not require Docker. Docker/Linux evidence remains required when that deployment environment is actually used.
Nonessential traffic flags and an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR were used; production still needs egress policy and legal review.
canUseTool blocked an outside path, but built-in Bash inherited the model credential environment variable.
An in-process MCP tool was registered, authorized and invoked exactly once.
A named child Agent ran once with no tools and a one-turn limit.

g4_required_controls: Process-tree supervision and forced descendant cleanup on cancel/timeout
Credential isolation so Bash and Agent-authored commands cannot read provider secrets
Workspace path policy through canUseTool or a platform MCP tool gateway
Explicit model-protocol routing instead of assuming every OpenAI endpoint supports Anthropic Messages
Docker Linux cold-start verification before a Linux/container deployment is released
